faq.q: Is Sprunk in Grand Theft Auto VI?
faq.a: Yes. Sprunk returns in GTA 6, confirmed in official trailers where its vending machines and billboards appear across Vice City.

faq.q: What real soda brand is Sprunk based on?
faq.a: Sprunk has served as the series' answer to Coca-Cola since Grand Theft Auto: Vice City in 2002, functioning as its long-running parody brand.

faq.q: Does Sprunk have a rival brand in GTA 6?
faq.a: Yes. Its long-standing rivalry with eCola, itself a nod to the Coke-versus-Pepsi rivalry, continues into Grand Theft Auto VI.

faq.q: Where do you see Sprunk in the GTA 6 trailers?
faq.a: Sprunk's vending machines and billboards appear across Vice City in both official trailers released so far for the game.

faq.q: Can players buy Sprunk drinks in GTA 6?
faq.a: Rockstar has not said. The record only confirms vending machines and billboards visible in trailer footage, not any interactive purchase mechanic.
